transcript: Teacher: Priya, tumhari mummy kahan hai? [Priya, where is your mother?] Student: My mother go to parlour. Teacher: My mother go to parlour? Sunke lagta hai tumhari mummy khud nahi gayi, koi unhe wahan le gaya. [My mother go to parlour? Sounds like she didn't go herself, but was taken.] Student: Toh kya bolun? [So what should I say?] Teacher: My mother went to the parlour. Ek baar bolo. [My mother went to the parlour. Say it once.] Student: My mother went to the parlour. Teacher: Ekdum sahi. Kabhi English Expert try kiya hai? [Exactly. Have you tried English Expert?] Student: Woh toh mehnge hote honge. [They must be expensive.] Teacher: Sirf ek rupaye ka trial hai. Roz sirf 15 minute mere saath practice karo. Main kabhi judge nahi karungi. [It's just a 1 rupee trial. Practice with me for 15 minutes daily. I won't judge.] Student: Main kaise join karoon? [How do I join?] Teacher: Install button dabao aur English Seekho app download karo. [Press the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: Priya. My mother go to parlour. My mother went to the parlour. English Seekho. Install Now. Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority.
summary: A teacher corrects a student's English grammar in a split-screen classroom setup. She introduces the English Seekho app as an affordable, non-judgmental AI tutor available for a 1-rupee trial. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
